messages:
Avery (PM): Quick sync — I posted the draft PRD for the rollout gating and fallback policies. Need cross-team sign-off by EOD tomorrow.
Raj (Eng): skimming now. main ask: confirm acceptance criteria include perf SLOs + fallbacks.
Mei (Infra): Adding infra checklist items: autoscaler bump plan, KV cache warming, and a load test schedule.
Carlos (QA): I'll add acceptance tests and a canary playbook. Will the canary traffic be synthetic or sampled prod?
Avery (PM): we decided sampled prod for realistic latencies but synthetic for load tests. doc has both sections.
Jenna (Design): UX note: fallback messages to the user must be non-technical and indicate degraded mode, not failure. Example copy in PRD.
Priya (Security): Need to confirm KMS key access in Dedicated and Private flows. Also logging retention for PII redaction.
Tom (Solutions): Customer asks: ability to pin a team to dedicated capacity during launch window. We should include a manual override in rollout matrix.
Raj (Eng): here's proposed rollout matrix snippet:
```
- 0% -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%
- If error rate > 3% for 5m -> rollback to previous stage
- If latency 95p > 450ms -> trigger fallback to cheaper variant
```
Carlos (QA): Acceptance criteria I added:
- functional: responses match golden prompts (fuzzy match >= 90%)
- reliability: <1% server errors during canary
- perf: 95p latency < 450ms under expected traffic profile
- safety: no high-severity hallucination regressions on eval set

Avery (PM): Edge cases to call out: cold-start on long-context requests, KV cache mismatch across region failovers, partial response from model due to OOM.
Mei (Infra): For cold-starts we can pre-warm on canary hosts, but long-context memory usage must be budgeted. I'll add pre-warm hooks.
Priya (Security): Also add a requirement: all logs containing model outputs must be filtered before long-term storage. Define transient logging window.
Jenna (Design): UX edge-case: when fallback returns a shorter answer, show a subtle hint "Condensed response due to load" with a link to retry. Approve? :thinking_face: 
Tom (Solutions): Works for customers. Also record decision to allow per-tenant manual pinning (audit log required).
Raj (Eng): Decision log entry proposed:
- Decision: support per-tenant capacity pin + manual override
- Rationale: enterprise customers require predictable latency during launches
- Rollback plan: manual unpin and fallback routing to hosted models

Carlos (QA): Question: what are the exact signal thresholds for auto-fallback? we have numbers but need final sign-off.
Avery (PM): current thresholds in PRD: error rate >3% for 5m OR token-per-second drop >20% OR 95p latency >450ms. Are those acceptable?
Mei (Infra): include an additional safety margin for noisy metrics: require 2 consecutive windows (5m each) before automated rollback.
Priya (Security): Confirmed — add a manual approval gate for changes to logging/retention.
Raj (Eng): I'll update the PRD with the consecutive-window requirement and the rollout matrix.
Avery (PM): Signoff checklist before EOD tomorrow:
- Engineering: finalize rollout numbers and rollback hooks (Raj)
- Infra: pre-warm and autoscaler runbook (Mei)
- QA: canary tests + golden evals (Carlos)
- Design: fallback microcopy (Jenna)
- Security: KMS/retention signoff (Priya)
- Solutions: customer pinning details + audit requirements (Tom)

Jenna (Design): I uploaded alternative microcopy in the doc and linked the styleguide.
Carlos (QA): Starting canary tests today at 13:00 PT, will post results here.
review-bot: New PRD comment by Avery (link: https://redwood.internal/prd/rollouts).
Avery (PM): tagging @Raj @Mei @Carlos @Jenna @Priya @Tom — please add explicit OK (or :no_entry_sign:) so I can capture sign-offs.
Raj (Eng): OK from eng, small follow-up on metrics naming in the doc.
Mei (Infra): OK, infra items tracked in the runbook.
Carlos (QA): OK once canary passes (will update later).
Jenna (Design): OK to microcopy.
Priya (Security): OK for KMS and retention with noted caveat (see PRD footnote).
Tom (Solutions): OK from solutions. Will notify customers with pinned capacity option.
Avery (PM): Thanks everyone — I'll collate these into the decision log and mark PRD as ready for RFC review. Leaving the thread open for any late blockers. :white_check_mark:
